---
title: "Terminology & Vocabulary Mapping"
hide:
  - toc
---

Interface terminologies (e.g., the clinical vocabularies used natively within an EHR) often differ from the standard vocabularies used in the OMOP CDM. Understanding how your source system's interface terminology relates to OMOP standard concepts is a key step in ETL design.

## Tools

•	[USAGI](https://github.com/OHDSI/Usagi) — OHDSI tool to support the manual mapping of source codes to standard OMOP concepts.

•	[Athena](http://Athena.ohdsi.org) — the OHDSI vocabulary repository, used to browse and download standardized vocabularies for mapping source codes to OMOP concepts.

•	[Custom Vocabulary Browser](https://ohdsi.github.io/CustomVocabularyBrowser/?repository=TuftsCTSI%2FCVB&ref=main&vocabulary=GIS) - an open source tool with an Athena inspired interface for custom OMOP concepts. The repo is located [here] (https://github.com/OHDSI/CustomVocabularyBrowser)

## Conventions

•	[Themis convention library](https://ohdsi.github.io/Themis/) — community conventions for consistent ETL/mapping decisions across the OHDSI network.
